not_money_ready_disclaimer: audit3 is an evidence ledger, not a signal service. PROVEN_T2 means the realized closed-pick ledger survives the listed gates; it does not guarantee future returns. No position sizing is emitted here.

cost_basis.note: per-strategy measured where available, measured class otherwise

conventions.win_definition: net pnl_pct > 0 after per-class round-trip slippage
conventions.edge_test: net-expectancy bootstrap CI, one-sided; WR is a descriptor only
conventions.p_value: one-sided bootstrap P(net mean <= 0), 2,000 seeded resamples
conventions.p_wr: one-sided exact binomial P(X>=wins) under p=0.5 — reported, never gated
conventions.promotion_rule: PROVEN_T2 = n>=100, net CI lower bound >= 0.05%/trade, stable halves, no symbol > 60%, source share <= 90%, BH q <= 0.1, DSR >= 0.95
conventions.cost_stress: net CI is also reported at 2x the class slippage constant (report-only; never changes a verdict)
conventions.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across tested cells; Bonferroni alpha/m = 0.001111
conventions.stability: chronological split-half, both halves net mean > 0
conventions.random_entry_mc: not run here (needs per-symbol price series); see alpha_engine/benchmark_closed_ledger.py for the timing-null companion report.

denominator.note: scores the payload export slice — the canonical view was absent, stale, or hashed differently, so this is NOT the same denominator as /audit

excluded_cohorts.reason: failed the publishing dashboard's own integrity checks (ghost rows, WON-vs-PnL sign contradictions, constant/zero pnl) and is removed before the export slice
resolved by timeout instead of TP/SL; a timeout is neither a win nor a loss, so it is dropped before scoring and never counted against the strategy either

coverage.statement: audit3 scores 3,500 of 16,330 closed picks (21.4%). The other 12,830 are not in this ledger: the publishing dashboard reports 7,502 integrity-excluded and 9,100 auto-expired rows, and no surface scores any of them. Those cohorts overlap, so they do not sum to the gap — read them as reasons rows are missing, not as a partition.

selection_alpha.definition: alpha = pick net return - direction-adjusted buy & hold over the same entry..exit window (M1b)
selection_alpha.why_it_matters: A +40% pick on a symbol that returned +60% is a selection failure; a win-rate or PF table cannot see that.

doctrine.name: innocent-until-proven-guilty
doctrine.default_state: not proven -- keep observing; absence of proof of edge is not evidence of harm
doctrine.kill_requires: net-expectancy bootstrap 95% CI entirely < 0 AND Benjamini-Hochberg harm q <= 0.10
doctrine.pf_rule: PF < 0.8 is a watch flag only
doctrine.nothing_deleted: no closed pick, strategy or section is removed from the ledger by this module

multiplicity.rule: BH is computed within each namespace; only confirmatory cells (pre-registered pods) may reach PROVEN_T2
